GRADE 4 KISWAHILI — TERM 2 EXAM

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: KISWAHILI
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Kuandika 4.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki darasani na rafiki yako, which statement is correct?
   A. kutambua barua ya kirafiki kwa kuzingatia muundo wake,
   B. Learners should ignore Kuandika 4.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki completely.
   C. Kuandika 4.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kuandika 4.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki.

2. About Kuandika 4.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki nyumbani na wazazi, which statement is correct?
   A. kujadili umuhimu wa barua ya kirafiki katika mawasiliano,
   B. Learners should ignore Kuandika 4.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki completely.
   C. Kuandika 4.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kuandika 4.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki.

3. About Kuandika 4.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki sokoni katika kaunti yako, which statement is correct?

   B. Learners should ignore Kuandika 4.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki completely.
   C. Kuandika 4.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kuandika 4.3.1 Barua ya Kirafiki.
